name: pingalert-pro
description: PingAlert Pro — Professional Network Monitoring System

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npx prisma db seed && cd ../frontend && npm install
